innovation.summary: The project demonstrates significant innovation in propulsion technology, particularly through the development of new generation thrusters that drastically reduce size and cost compared to traditional systems. Key advancements include the introduction of a micro laser thruster, which is unique in its capability to be launched into space, and a mini thruster that contributes to reduced launch weight and costs.
key_points: The volume of fuel storage tanks has been reduced to one-fifth to one-tenth of traditional chemical propulsion systems.
The new generation of chemical thrusters used in domestic small satellites has a volume reduced to one percent of the original.
The cost of propellant for the new generation of chemical thrusters is reduced to one-thirtieth of the original.
中科纳飞 has developed a micro laser thruster that is the only one in the world capable of being launched into space.
The propulsion system features a mini thruster that reduces launch weight by 30 kg and saves 3 million in launch costs.
The organization holds 7 invention patents and 2 software copyrights related to propulsion technology.

feasibility.summary: The feasibility of the project is influenced by several factors, including identified risks related to electric propulsion technology and budgetary considerations. Key risks include bottlenecks in storage density and the high cost of xenon gas, while mitigations involve the development of a mini thruster that reduces launch weight and costs.
key_points: Current bottlenecks in electric propulsion technology include low storage density, high dry mass, high-pressure storage tanks, and valve systems.
Xenon gas is costly, and there are issues with cathode corrosion and lifespan.
